Never silently substitute a default for required context (workspace_id, tenant, auth, venue, side, api_key). Fail fast / raise — silent fallbacks are invisible bugs. A localhost/empty-string env default reaches connection-refused then a wrong lot_size=1 quantity.

Gateway is auth + routing + proxy ONLY. Any date-extraction, result mutation, LLM-hallucination guard, or data transformation in the gateway is a boundary violation — move it to backend result-assembly.

Bare `except Exception:` on order place/modify/cancel/sweep/reconcile/margin/price-snap silently undoes the surrounding fix (e.g. _snap_to_tick shipped un-snapped prices). Use an explicit exception list + logger.warning + labelled Prometheus counter.

`if "some text" in str(exc)` is fragile. Use typed exceptions per error category — a 401 (AUTH_EXPIRED) is fundamentally different from empty data; broker read methods must raise typed BrokerReadError on 4xx/5xx, return [] only on 2xx-unparseable.

Test/debug bypass flags (SKIP_LIVE_GATE, SKIP_MARGIN_CHECK, BYPASS_*) must default-deny — honour only when ENV in an explicit allowlist {test,dev,development}. A bare `ENV != production` admits staging + unset ENV; emit a loud alert log AND increment a labelled counter on every bypass.
Never clear a broader-scope safety flag as a side-effect of a narrower action. Activating one deployment must not lift account/workspace kill-switch — same-scope, audited actions only.
A derived/child credential (access token from auth token) must clamp TTL to min(own, parent) and persist to DB. A 4h access token over a 1h auth token causes AUTH_EXPIRED storms.

Every free-form string interpolated into an LLM prompt (lang, tone, persona, symbol) is a prompt-injection vector — constrain to an enum/allowlist at the boundary. `?lang=ignore all previous instructions` is the exploit.

A 75-file / 9500-line PR mixing NLP + E2E infra + frontend + executor + ETL is unreviewable — 'most changes irrelevant to the problems the PR tackles'. Split atomic by concern (pre-prod: bundle one coherent concern; post-prod: one-PR-per-concern).
Never commit .venv/.gstack/test-results/screenshots/node_modules/dist/__pycache__/.env. Never `git add -A`/`git add .` — add files by name; verify `git diff --stat` is scope-only before PR.
Every new package.json/pyproject dependency must be grep-proven as actually imported before commit (franc added to gateway, never imported = 200KB dead weight + supply-chain surface).

No `pass` bodies, no `expect(true).toBe(true)`, no auto-xfail conftest hooks converting import failures to expected-pass. Unimplemented tests use explicit skip(reason). 60-passed/40-xfail that tests nothing is false coverage.

'A number is present' is not a test. Cross-validate every displayed metric against the source DB row + expected transform. Scale bugs (0-1 vs 0-100, double ×100 → 4125% IV Rank) are the most common correctness defect.

Every new data component (card/metric/count/status) must ship data-testid; tests assert via locator, never document.body.textContent keyword search — LLM-generated prose always contains the keyword and masks a broken card.

When dedup/filtering drops records, log a warning with instrument/period/reason. Options bhavcopy ran 425 days with numeric underlying IDs instead of NIFTY because only row-counts were checked — verify field VALUES not just counts.

A schema/desugar change that silently drops a value (is_percent_of dropping the 3% threshold) is worse than the loud Pydantic rejection it replaced. Trace the full LLM→compiler→evaluator flow; a loud failure beats a silent wrong result.

'Pre-existing issue' / 'probably stale DB' / 'LLM non-determinism, can't repro' are banned labels. If we touched the area we own the full E2E flow; every bug has a deterministic code-path RCA — find where working vs failing flows diverge.

A green that exists only because every dependency is mocked does NOT qualify a PR — validate on REAL data (real LLM not LLM_PROVIDER=mock, real CH, real backtester, real consumer path). Adding mocks to green a hanging test is the inverse of fixing it.

A direct KiteConnect.place_order() from a dev box is not a live test — it skips executor/relay/persistence/pre-trade-gate; its IP-reject is a wrong-path artifact, not a prod signal. Drive the real user→backend→executor→relay→broker path.

Never claim RCA/bug without deterministic proof ('MOFSL token expires 15min' was actually 17h TTL + single-session invalidation). Reproduce red-on-revert before fixing; label unconfirmed as Hypothesis; re-verify a candidate blocker with 2 independent agents.

Default is FIX (rca→fix→test→verify→PR), not file a tracking issue. 'Source isn't in this checkout' was false after one narrow grep — search hard for the raise-site; 'big/risky' means fix carefully, not punt.

Every user-facing PR must carry the smoke NL(s) in the body and have run them on the real chat→agent path against real staging data — an absent/un-run NL is a retroactive do-not-merge. Don't cite an infra blocker (OpenAI quota, 'no data') without testing the real path first.

A logic/code read cannot catch runtime-interaction bugs — inline ref={el=>el.focus()} stealing focus every render, useEffect deps with fresh-identity objects re-subscribing, controlled-input reset on a 3s feed reconnect. Review against the parent's re-render cadence.

Frontend CI gates on prettier `format:check` as a distinct job — lint+typecheck+unit passing does NOT cover it. Run the service's full check (pnpm --filter <svc> run check) before push or eat a force-push round-trip.

Second-provider refactors fail as 'dispatch landed in some sites but not others'. Prove with an opposite-value MockProvider automated walker test across every dispatch surface (picker, callback parse, spawn, sweep, reconcile) — a grep can't prove the runtime reads the registry.

Every value-dispatch (provider×venue, venue×asset_class) must whitelist the full canonical set AND raise on unknown — a `?: NFO` fallback silently mis-routes BFO/NCDEX/MCX legs to NSE. Add a test asserting unknown values raise.

Synonym event names across handler classes (order_rejected vs broker_order_rejected) produce 0 audit rows (SEBI gap) when the dispatcher is an if/elif cascade — dispatcher must be a flat lookup dict, canonical vocabulary enforced.
A timeout is a bug to investigate (O(n²) perf, missing data, broken flow, missing chart type), never a test to skip or a limit to bump. Distinguish TIMEOUT from FAIL; flag HIGH severity.

open('/tmp/..','a'), print(), ad-hoc CSV dumps, and NEW-XX DEBUG info-level lines must be removed before merge — /tmp is ephemeral/unwritable in hardened targets and fires every order. Ship diagnostics via logger.debug gated on <FEATURE>_DEBUG.
Never use --no-verify or --no-gpg-sign. A failing pre-commit hook is a root cause to fix, not to skip; force-push amend to remove a --no-verify commit is a review ask.
